verdicts.reason: A: the white Meridian logo sits on the white strip beside the header, so it is almost invisible and the brand is broken. The fare list mixes tiny two-column rows (Paris/Rome, Madrid/London) with oversized single rows (Berlin, Vienna), so the list loses its order and sizing and has large dead gaps; the legal text is crammed beside the CTA. B: it is basically the original placed in the middle of the wider canvas rather than reflowed. The blue header stops short of the canvas edges, leaving white side strips that look unfinished, but the hierarchy, list order, logo and CTA are all intact and readable.
